tender.description: Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of one set of 120V, 400Ah high-discharge Plante type lead-acid battery bank, comprising 60 nos. 2V/400Ah Plante cells, along with buy-back of 60 nos. existing 2V/400Ah (YKP33) cells at LTPS.
